biggest_catch: The friend must set up a real direct deposit or ACH autopayment AND enroll in digital banking AND keep the account open with a positive balance for 90 days - a plain account opening earns you nothing.
catches: Referrer earns a $100 bonus per successful referral; limit 5 ($500) for the promotional period.

Friend must be a new checking customer, register using the referral code, open a new checking account, and within 90 days: have a direct deposit or ACH automatic payment, enroll in digital banking, and keep the account open with a positive balance.
Direct deposits exclude ATM/mobile deposits and transfers; ACH autopayments exclude internal transfers and ATM withdrawals.
Referrer must be a current customer of First National Bank of Fort Smith, NWA, CNB, or NBS.
Bonuses may be reported as income to the IRS; program may be discontinued or changed at any time without notice.
